newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thailand delays Feb 20-Jun 30 corn import schedule.
newsitem.headline: Thailand delays Feb 20-Jun 30 corn import schedule.

text.p: The Thai cabinet on Tuesday decided to delay the schedule for the import of tariff-free corn set earlier to take effect from February 20-June 30.
Amnaj Chanawongse, deputy government spokesman, said a new schedule would be decided on later by the commerce minister, depending on the local corn demand, supply and price situations.
The move to delay the plan also aimed to encourage animal feed producers to buy more local corn following a rise in supplies.
Farmers complained that some feed producers awaited imports and had slowed down buying of local material, causing prices to go down.
"This should help solve the problem. The cabinet left it to the commerce minister to choose a new schedule, based on the corn stock condition," Amnaj said.
However, the delay would not affect importers in the frozen poultry export business.
In a move to boost sagging exports, the government has offered a full refund on the feed raw material tariff for those operating in the industry.
